findings.issue: NEW-2 (BLOCKING internal contradiction). REQ-008 specifies the /health body literal as exactly `{ "status": "ok", "service": "x402-agents" }`. findings.location: behavioral-spec.md:15 (§Done point (c)) vs :65 (Out of scope — F3 gas seed)
findings.issue: NEW-1 (NON-BLOCKING under lean, would be BLOCKING under strict). F1 §Done point (c) requires 'a single self-buy on Base mainnet for POST /social/x reaches a successful settle on-chain'. A successful Base-mainnet settle costs Base ETH gas on the founder wallet. §Out of scope explicitly defers gas-seeding to F3 ('Gas seeding $1 Base ETH onto 0x810f — F3'). So the literal F1 done definition requires a capability the spec assigns to a later feature: F1 cannot be declared 'done' until F3 (or an equivalent manual seed) has put gas on 0x810f. The §Done block in lines 13-16 acknowledges F1 done ≠ GOAL done but is silent on whether §Done (c) is gated on F3 / a manual one-shot seed. An autonomous builder loop reading the spec will hit this and freeze.
findings.fix: Either (a) explicitly state in §Done point (c) that 'a one-shot manual gas seed of $1 Base ETH onto X402_WALLET_ADDRESS is a prerequisite for §Done (c); F3 productionizes this seed as an automated capability', or (b) move §Done (c)+(d) to a 'F1+F3-conjunction done condition' and remove them from F1's standalone done, or (c) split the spec into F1a (impl + boot, no on-chain) and F1b (self-buy seed, gated on F3 being satisfied).
